Churg Elvek is a human character in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate. He is near the Grey Harbour Docks, fomenting a mob of people ready to bring  Volo to "justice".

Involvement

As the party approach the Steel Watch Foundry, they can come across Churg Elvek and his mob, as well as Volo who is tied up to several  Smokepowder Barrels. Upon approach, a cutscene plays out where Churg accusses Volo of harmful lies, conspiracies and fear mongering. The party can intervene or draw their weapons after which Churg and his mob attack.

If  Minsc is in the party, he comments on the situation and the party immediately goes into combat.
